# The `sdk-upload` CI job (ci.yml): the engine-pinned PyTorch set, plus the
# tracebloc SDK at a RELEASED version, so tests/test_sdk_upload_from_clone.py
# runs the upload checks a user's `pip install tracebloc` runs.
#
# Pinned exactly, and bumped by hand when a release changes what upload_model
# checks. The SDK's own torch/torchvision caps match the engine's pins (it
# validates on the minor the training images run), so this resolves against
# pytorch.txt without overriding it.
-r pytorch.txt
tracebloc[pytorch]==1.2.44
